ruins.name: Ruins' Rhapsody
desc: Play as a daring archaeologist hunting for an ancient mysterious relic.
This action-adventure demo, inspired by Tomb Raider and Uncharted, blends a dynamic movement system,
environmental puzzles and gunfights against robots in ancient ruins.

goblin.name: Goblin Jr. Adventure
desc: Guide a courageous little goblin through colorful, stylized cube worlds.
Designed for kids and casual players, with a focus on accessibility and immediate fun,
this collect-a-thon platformer is a short but thrilling experience full of traps,
hidden secrets and glittering treasures.

zombie.name: Zombie Siege Chronicles
desc: A group project created for the Rookie Awards 2024.
Defend your base from relentless zombie waves using turrets, barriers and special structures
in this isometric tower defense game.
I built the core systems: the portal network, collision-based placement validation,
survivor rescue events and the data-driven shop UI.

flying.name: Flying Bird
desc: A 3D remake of the iconic mobile game Flappy Bird,
available on Windows and Android.
Guide the bird through obstacles with simple one-touch controls
and chase the highest score in an endless run.

wizard.name: WizardScape: The Magic Chase
desc: A Android survival action game where you control a young wizard
with an auto-cast spell combat system.
Choose your upgrades, manage diamond-based power-ups and survive increasingly difficult enemy waves.
Pre-Alpha demo showcasing core mechanics in both C++ and Blueprints.

more.name: More to come...
desc: More projects are on the way!
In the meantime, explore my GitHub and GitLab repositories for a closer look at my code.
